verdict.rationale: NVIDIA provides official SDKs (CUDA Toolkit, Nsight tools, HPC SDK) for building GPU-accelerated applications on H200, and community evidence confirms real-world builds (e.g., Llama 405B inference deployment) using H200 hardware. However, this is hardware-level GPU SDK support rather than AI-agent-specific SDKs, and probes show missing structured docs/OpenAPI endpoints, suggesting less polished AI-native developer experience. Missing for 10: dedicated agentic/AI-native SDK documentation, working machine-readable API specs, independent hands-on corroboration of SDK usability.
